mapper.select: SELECT #{statDate} AS stat_date, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `order` WHERE create_time >= #{statDate} AND create_time < DATE_ADD(#{statDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY)) AS order_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `order` WHERE pay_status = 1 AND order_status IN (1, 2, 3) AND create_time >= #{statDate} AND create_time < DATE_ADD(#{statDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY)) AS paid_order_count, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) FROM `order` WHERE pay_status = 1 AND order_status IN (1, 2, 3) AND create_time >= #{statDate} AND create_time < DATE_ADD(#{statDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY)) AS paid_user_count, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(pay_amount), 0) FROM `order` WHERE pay_status = 1 AND order_status IN (1, 2, 3) AND create_time >= #{statDate} AND create_time < DATE_ADD(#{statDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY)) AS sales_amount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM refund WHERE status = 3 AND create_time >= #{statDate} AND create_time < DATE_ADD(#{statDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY)) AS refund_count, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) FROM refund WHERE status = 3 AND create_time >= #{statDate} AND create_time < DATE_ADD(#{statDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY)) AS refund_amount, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) FROM browse_history WHERE browse_time >= #{statDate} AND browse_time < DATE_ADD(#{statDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY)) AS visitor_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `user` WHERE create_time >= #{statDate} AND create_time < DATE_ADD(#{statDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY)) AS new_user_count
SELECT * FROM daily_business_stats WHERE stat_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} ORDER BY stat_date

SELECT NULL AS stat_date, COALESCE(SUM(order_count), 0) AS order_count, COALESCE(SUM(paid_order_count), 0) AS paid_order_count, COALESCE(SUM(paid_user_count), 0) AS paid_user_count, COALESCE(SUM(sales_amount), 0) AS sales_amount, COALESCE(SUM(refund_count), 0) AS refund_count, COALESCE(SUM(refund_amount), 0) AS refund_amount, COALESCE(SUM(visitor_count), 0) AS visitor_count, COALESCE(SUM(new_user_count), 0) AS new_user_count FROM daily_business_stats
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO daily_business_stats (stat_date, order_count, paid_order_count, paid_user_count, sales_amount, refund_count, refund_amount, visitor_count, new_user_count) VALUES (#{statDate}, #{orderCount}, #{paidOrderCount}, #{paidUserCount}, #{salesAmount}, #{refundCount}, #{refundAmount}, #{visitorCount}, #{newUserCount}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE order_count = VALUES(order_count), paid_order_count = VALUES(paid_order_count), paid_user_count = VALUES(paid_user_count), sales_amount = VALUES(sales_amount), refund_count = VALUES(refund_count), refund_amount = VALUES(refund_amount), visitor_count = VALUES(visitor_count), new_user_count = VALUES(new_user_count)
